title: Pocketwire Advance Rate Card — Grace, Late Fees and Waiver Allowances
content:
Pocketwire Advance tiers differ in how long an unpaid advance has before it counts as late, what a late fee costs, and how many fee waivers the tier allows. The rate card below sets those figures per tier.

| Tier | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Weekly late-fee percentage (of unpaid principal) | Late-fee period length (calendar days) | Minimum late fee per period (USD) | Late fee cap (percent of the advance's principal) | Courtesy late-fee waivers per calendar year | Cancellation window (full hours after disbursement) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 7 | 1.25 | 7 | 1.00 | 5.00 | 0 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 7 | 1.25 | 7 | 1.00 | 5.00 | 1 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 7 | 1.25 | 7 | 1.00 | 5.00 | 1 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 10 | 1.00 | 7 | 1.00 | 4.00 | 1 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 10 | 1.00 | 7 | 0.50 | 4.00 | 2 | 48 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 14 | 0.75 | 7 | 0.50 | 3.00 | 2 | 48 |

## Column notes

- **Grace period** — the calendar days after the due date before an unpaid advance makes the line past due.
- **Weekly late-fee percentage** — the late fee charged per full week past the grace period, as a percentage of unpaid principal.
- **Late-fee period length** — the length of one late-fee period, in calendar days.
- **Minimum late fee per period** — the smallest late fee charged for one period.
- **Late fee cap** — the cap on the late fees of one advance, as a percentage of its principal.
- **Courtesy late-fee waivers per calendar year** — the number of late fees that can be waived as a courtesy in one calendar year.
- **Cancellation window** — the full hours after disbursement within which repaying the advance in full cancels it and waives its flat fee.

## Reading the card

- A late-fee period is 7 calendar days on every tier; what differs is the grace period before the first period begins, which is 7 days on the three lowest tiers, 10 days on Pocketwire Advance Plus and Pocketwire Advance Max, and 14 days on Pocketwire Advance Elite.
- Pocketwire Advance Starter allows 0 courtesy late-fee waivers in a calendar year.
- The cancellation window is 24 full hours on Pocketwire Advance Starter to Pocketwire Advance Plus and 48 full hours on Pocketwire Advance Max and Pocketwire Advance Elite.
